description: This Java source file defines the OfbizUrlBuilder class, which is responsible for constructing full URLs and URL components within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for building complete URLs, host parts, and path parts based on configurations, request properties, and security settings. The class interacts with various OFBiz components like WebSiteProperties, ConfigXMLReader, and Delegator to generate context-aware URLs.

classes.name: OfbizUrlBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for constructing and managing URLs within the OFBiz framework, considering security, configuration, and request context.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates an OfbizUrlBuilder instance based on HttpServletRequest, extracting configuration, delegator, and website properties from the request or context.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates an OfbizUrlBuilder instance without HttpServletRequest, using WebappInfo and Delegator to initialize configuration and web properties.

methods.name: buildFullUrl
methods.description: Constructs a complete URL with scheme, host, servlet path, and resource.

methods.name: buildHostPart
methods.description: Builds the scheme and host part of the URL, considering HTTPS settings and request map security attributes.

methods.name: buildPathPart
methods.description: Builds the servlet path and resource path components of the URL, with optional path shortening.
